Hi all — thanks for the list. Responses below and updated attachments.

Answers: 
1) SOC 2 Type II: Yes — attached bridge letter and link to the full report under NDA. We can execute an NDA immediately; report available within 24 hours after.
2) Device Posture: Okta supports posture checks via both managed MDM (Intune, Workspace ONE) and browser-based posture agents for unmanaged endpoints. Enforcements can be policy-based (require MDM + compliant posture) or advisory.
3) Telemetry: device posture checks collect device attributes (OS version, patch level, certs) and these are processed within Okta systems. We do not forward posture telemetry to third-party analytics by default. Enterprise logging/forwarding can be configured to a customer-owned SIEM.
4) SCIM/API: there are no breaking changes planned in API v2 for the coming quarter; we’ll provide migration notes if anything changes.

Commercials/update: attached updated quote with a 17% renewal credit for a 24-month commit and waiving 50% of the implementation SOW fees for Device Posture. Attached SOW outlines a typical 4-week rollout with milestones.

Attachments: Okta_Renewal_Quote_2026_v2.pdf, Okta_DevicePosture_SOW_2026.pdf, Okta_SOC2_Bridge_Ltr.pdf

Let me know if you want a short (30-min) technical call with our device posture PM and a commercial rep this week.

Best,
